label: Propagating a candidate through a wire
section: Propagating a candidate through a wire
subgoals: Compute the wire's Elmore delay from its resistance and the downstream load
Subtract the delay from the required time
Add the wire capacitance to the load

label: Inserting a buffer
subgoals: Charge the buffer's intrinsic delay plus its drive resistance times the load
Replace the load by the buffer's input capacitance
Keep only the best buffered candidate since they share a load

label: Pruning and choosing at the driver
section: Pruning and choosing at the driver
subgoals: Discard any candidate beaten in both load and required time
Subtract the driver delay at the source and keep the best slack
